description: This file defines the interface 'LoanProductWritePlatformService' for writing operations related to loan products, including creating and updating loan products, within the Fineract project.

classes.name: LoanProductWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface for loan product write operations such as creating and updating loan products.

methods.name: createLoanProduct
methods.description: Creates a new loan product based on the provided JSON command.

methods.name: updateLoanProduct
methods.description: Updates an existing loan product identified by loanProductId with data from the JSON command.
